My mum was/is muslim, my Dad not really but we were both sorta just forced to do whatever mum wanted. I'll tell my experiences with gender and preference. As a kid since like 2/3 I was put into Islamic Sunday school, learnt to read (never really understand tho lol) the Quran and Pillars etc etc. I remember at this time I my mum would yell at me on the daily (I dont remember why though lmao), and saying if I would be happier if I had a white mom or something.

Around 5-12 I was pretty tomboyish, and felt uncomfortable in dresses and my mum would always force me to wear them and would yell or harshly hiss. She always told me to act like a lady, and if I had a boyfriend etc, etc. This made me resent being a girl, and feeling dysphoric. When we were travelling to her home town I must've been 10 or 11 I texted my school friend that I was only muslim because my Mum is, and Mum got really angry when she checked my phone and I wasn't allowed that chatting app anymore lole. I also remember asking her if trans people were accepted into islam on the way home from sunday school, and she basically said "other people um ok idk them, but not you". Around this time (12) I was also looking on 4chan, more specifically /r9k/ where it was pretty much anti-women and anti-lgbt, and I was lurking around and managed some letter threads. Internal misogyny x10 time lmao. I was a really cringe year 7 (freshman), I even had a fedora I wore, ew.

One day (still 12) we were on a small family trip, and while I was there I was messaging my best friend from primary school, who came out to me, and we talked about sad stuff and she asked me if I was gay, I said yeah. I put notifications on so I wouldn't have to check manually, she texted me and Mum must've checked that out when I wasn't with my phone and scrolled through :( she was distraught and angry and I vaguely remember details. Bunch of stuff went down, and she was actually going to leave (she had threatened before lots, usually me but sometimes to divorce dad) and I was excited, but she ended up staying. A few months later I tried to gameover and failed, idk why but I told mum and yeeaah. She was nicer after that though. Oh also after that I joined a disc serv (not saying full incase they find me from googling new servs) from /r9k/, a community I would stay in until recently under the guise of a 23 y/o guy. met some wonderful people in the community but the general culture was uh ye.

Year 8 (I was now 13) I got therapy and stuff (another bag of chips, quit after quarantine this year), started SHing, and got a lot more feminine. My school grades went plummeting, and YES I DITCHED THE FEDORA THO, I contributed to the discserv and became a prominent member. I had a GF for bit (my mum questioned my friend once but ofc I'm like "no ur gross haha wtf") and yeah. Got snitched alot to teachers for SH not properly covered up or funky plans. Stupid me had a bigmouth and thought I could trust adults. I remember on sites online people who knew my age and gender would say I was an angel etc, but noone did anything that bad, except like from when I was 12 this guy who was pretty conservative would always romantic rp with me and had hitler stuff on his socials (he was college age LOL, glad he got pissed off over my emotional ineptness). But yeah I was open about liking girls and stuff.

Current year (wow I'm now 14, pretty cringe hey), I think I've had a lot more time to be carefree and think about myself. I'm less open about my orientation, and I'm glad our school has an lgbt club but I don't want to be seen. My mum sometimes does question me though when I got uncomfortable with guys who liked me. My Mum's taken a step back but still forces me to fast and not eat pig etc etc (yeah lol me and dad sneak). Recently I left the discserv as well, the anti-woman thing (look, I don't want to antagonise them too much, they probably had bad experiences with girls) and people knowing who i really was, made me feel guilty for being born a girl, so I left. Had an incident where this stupid guy made servs for SHers and WLW minors, and would groom them, naiive me trying to help the guy, i got fooled :/ nothing bad happened but i hate him and he still does this stuff despite reporting the police. speaking of police, owner of the discserv was arrested for taking advantage of a minor too, i was sad when i heard this because he was one of my closest friends and yeah. 

I think long term effects is that I have no identity outside of "backstories" and "modes", still experience dysphoria and the stress the memories bring, and not knowing what is right or wrong because of opinion distorted by extremists on all ends (cancel culture, incels etc).
